title: A profile of Alona Katz, chief of Brooklyn DA's Virtual Currency Unit, who recently led an operation that seized and disrupted over 240 crypto fraud websites (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: A profile of Alona Katz, chief of Brooklyn DA's Virtual Currency Unit, who recently led an operation that seized and disrupted over 240 crypto fraud websites — Crypto scams cost Americans more than $11 billion last year. A Brooklyn prosecutor found a way to hit the networks behind them.
